text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting today, Seiun Sky and I will finally be taking on the Twinkle Series… at least we're supposed to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's our first day of training, but she invites me to some early morning fishing for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sky reels in a big, encouraging catch. In racing, just as in fishing, there's nothing more important than preparing the right tools.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Is she a carefree delinquent or a scheming tactician? My days chasing the "biggest catch" with this elusive Umamusume begin!
